snippet.title: Voltron: Defender of the Universe PS3 Playthrough
snippet.description:
Playthrough of the PS3 version of Voltron: Defender of the Universe.


Note: Sadly, due to copyright reasons, all cutscenes (including the forming of Voltron quick time sequences) had to be removed.
